title: Lessons in Enlightened Hospitality
coreMove: Enlightened hospitality makes care operational: put people first, assume generously, and keep steady pressure on standards without losing grace.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Enlightened hospitality reorders the same stakeholders every business has into a deliberate sequence , employees first, then guests, then community, then suppliers, with investors
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply the lesson to this situation without copying a surface gesture.

exampleSpecs.stakes: If you want a frontline team to obsess over how guests feel, leadership has to obsess first over how the team itself feels; the care cascades downward and financial reward follows
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply the lesson to this situation without copying a surface gesture.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Small, unprompted, non-essential gestures , the kind nobody requested , are not garnish on an experience but the place where the real impact of hospitality lives.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply the lesson to this situation without copying a surface gesture.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A shared, memorable internal vocabulary is a cultural tool: compact catchphrases let a value spread and survive the chaos of a busy restaurant floor.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply the lesson to this situation without copying a surface gesture.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Stories of generous gestures, retold inside an organization, become the mechanism by which a culture replicates itself and prompts people to invent their own versions.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply the lesson to this situation without copying a surface gesture.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Extending grace before judgment , assuming good intent when a colleague falls short , is itself an act of hospitality directed inward at the team, not only outward at guests.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apply the lesson to this situation without copying a surface gesture.
